noise_model: Independent zero-mean Gaussian perturbation added to each RF/FSO/THz SNR observation in the held-out test set.
labels: Preserved from the clean physical reference policy.
energy_consistency: For noisy full-information observations, capacity and transmit-energy-per-bit features were recomputed from the perturbed SNR, channel bandwidth, and transmit power; clean Eb values were not retained.
training: Models trained only on clean training data.
evaluation: 10 grouped realization-level splits; each split holds out 2 of 10 complete realizations per scenario.
environment_only_control: Unaffected by SNR measurement noise because SNR/Eb are not model inputs.
interpretation: This experiment evaluates measurement uncertainty only; it does not represent propagation-model mismatch or environmental-variable uncertainty.
